sentence: A shared three-day trip timeline where group members add stops by day and time of day, tap a stop to confirm they are in, and move or remove stops they added.
use_when: The group is planning a weekend trip and wants one shared list of stops by day
People need to see who is coming to each stop
Someone wants to add or move a stop in a short itinerary
The trip has a fixed leave-by time on the last day
dont_use_when: The group needs to vote between options or pick a winner
The plan is longer than three days or needs exact clock times and maps
The group needs to split costs or track expenses
The task is a to-do list or packing list rather than a schedule
